_doc: 2026-10-31 (user: the skill shows only on the cells, nothing is cast out of the character). Cast projectiles made with the PixelLab VFX workbench (free). units: character id -> pack id (default for any other hero). Per pack: dir under assets/art/vfx/cast/, clip (loop, anchor = the effect's origin), hand = art-px offset from the hero's feet where the projectile leaves (hero facing right), aim_lift = art px above a target cell's feet anchor it flies to, travel_sec = flight time, landing exactly when the swing resolves, gesture_lead_sec = how far into the cast_gesture clip the slash frame comes (the clip starts that much before the launch). OSFE beats (design/references/osfe-spell-anatomy.md, user 2026-11-01): path row = the projectile flies straight along the hero's row to the nearest target column (aim_lift unused); charge = a cast pack looping at the hand for charge_sec before the launch; cell_blast = a FloorVfx overlay one-shot played on every cell of a resolved cut whose card effect is in blast_effects, the nearest column first and each further column stagger_sec later. hit_feel = the white flash (add blend) and shake on a unit that takes damage. blast_peak_sec = how far into a cell's blast its brightest frame comes: the target's hit flash and shake wait for its own cell's blast delay plus this. gesture_hold_frame = the cast_gesture frame (0-based) the hero holds while the swing telegraph runs (the coil of the v4 wind-up, 2026-11-01); the clip plays from the swing start, stops on it, and jumps to the next frame (the slash) gesture_lead_sec before the launch. -1 / absent = the old behaviour (held on frame 0). Wave flow (user 2026-11-01, 'like a sea wave'): path first_cell = the projectile flies straight from the hand to the area cell nearest the hero; for a card effect in blast_effects it does not vanish there but flows on through the area like water, cell to neighbour cell (breadth-first from the first cell), flow_step_sec per step, lingering flow_tail_sec on the last cells; each cell is hit when the wave reaches it. cell_blast "" = no separate per-cell effect. Flood (user 2026-11-01 correction: 'chạm ô đầu tiên sau đó nổ ra cái vết tràn về sau'): the projectile explodes on the first cell (impact = a FloorVfx overlay one-shot there) and ONE connected stain floods the area on the floor from that cell, each cell wiped in from the neighbour it was reached from in flow_step_sec, held hold_sec, faded over fade_sec (flood: fill / edge colours, alpha, edge_px). No separate projectiles run through the cells. v2 (user reference board 2026-11-01): flight ~0.25 s, a ground burst on the first cell, then each further cell lights gold (outline + cracks, a burst = cell_burst, square tessera shards rising) one flow_step_sec after its neighbour; all lit cells stay until the last one is lit, then fade together over fade_sec. first_hold_sec = the touch + big explosion on the first cell before the spread starts (reference board 2: 250-300 ms touch, 300-380 ms big burst, then 80 ms per spread step, fade 620-800 ms). flood.tiles false (user 2026-11-01: 'ko cần cái phần tô vàng các ô'): no gold fill / outline / cracks on the cells, only the bursts spreading and the shards.

sword_wave._doc_task5: ADR-0001 Phase 1 Task 5 (2026-11-01, pack 01 §1A): the crescent wave art (dir sword_wave, kept on disk) is no longer drawn: travel_draw square_streak draws a code-drawn stepped square streak in the hero's block colours with the same travel_sec / timing. impact big_burst (its oval glowing base is baked into the frames) is replaced by small_burst plus the code-drawn square cell flash (travel_style.flash).
sword_wave._doc_task5_impact: Task 5 item 2 (2026-11-01): impact / cell_burst small_burst (a yellow diamond base baked into its frames) no longer play; every reached cell gets the code-drawn square impact of the card's delivery impact (impact_style) instead.

square_wave_steel._doc: 2026-11-02 (user: install the Knight packs, docs/plans/animation-pipeline.md): the sword cast drawn by the tools/fx-pipeline packs (recipe kiem_khi). Same timing as sword_wave. dir = the travel pack (sword qi of squares, flies hand -> first cell); release = a cast pack played once at the hand from gesture_lead_sec before the launch (the horizontal cut); impact / cell_burst = FloorVfx overlay bursts on the first / every other cell; impact_mark / cell_mark = FloorVfx floor squares left on them; these packs replace the code-drawn impact shards (impact_style) for this cast; flood.squares 0 = no code shards either. sword_wave stays as it was (rollback: units.kiem_si -> sword_wave).

_doc_delivery: ADR-0001 A1 (2026-11-01): a card's delivery (assets/data/cards.json, SkillDelivery) names a semantic impact and travel id; these maps turn them into FloorVfx one-shot packs (assets/art/vfx/floor/index.json, play 'once' packs only). "" = nothing drawn for it yet (Task 5 adds art). The hero projectile (the pack above) flies only for a delivery whose origin is 'caster'; the sword-wave visuals (impact on the first cell, flood shards, first_hold) play for CASTER_TO_TARGET with travel 'hero_pack'. Arrival timing lives in assets/data/combat.json timing.delivery, not here: flow_step_sec / first_hold_sec of a pack no longer time the hits (flow_step_sec still paces the flood reveal).
_doc_impact_marks: 2026-11-04 (user: VFX Pháp sư): per delivery impact, a FloorVfx floor pack left on every hit cell after its impact_packs burst (hoa_tran embers); an impact with a pack in impact_packs draws no code flash / shards (CastVfx.impact_pack_owns_cells).
_doc_task5: ADR-0001 Phase 1 Task 5 (2026-11-01): code-drawn cast presentation (CastFloorFx). block_colours: character id -> [block body, highlight] (art bible 'Khối của năm anh hùng'; '_enemy' = the enemy block #CFC6B4 / Ngà; 'default' for any other id). travel_style: per code-drawn travel id its square numbers (art px / seconds): square_streak (count, size, spacing), falling_squares (count, size, drop_sec = how long before each cell's arrival the squares start falling, height), chain_spark (size, lift = hop height), floor_run (count, size, trail_sec); flash = the square impact flash on each reached cell (sec); charge = the target cells while the player's swing charges (steps, fill_alpha [lo, hi], outline_px, check_px = the ✓ pixel size on the foe's cell). travel_packs below stay FloorVfx one-shots on the travel cells (floor_run miss_dust); the four square travels are drawn in code on top of them.

pit._doc: Task 5 item 3: CastFloorFx.pit_colours tuning (see PIT_TUNING): rim = face_top lightened, back wall = deck lightened, middle band deck->face, deep floor face->Ink.

_doc_impact_style: Task 5 item 2 (2026-11-01): impact_packs above are all "": the FloorVfx packs small_burst / cell_slash (diamond base baked in) and hit_impact / thorn_spikes / engraving_complete stay on disk but no card impact plays them. impact_style = per SkillDelivery impact the code-drawn square shards (CastFloorFx.impact_rects) over sec seconds from each reached cell's arrival, on top of the square flash, only on a hit; colours = [body, highlight] hex from the art bible, or "block" = the caster's block colours (block_colours; the boss uses _enemy). No red (#E5293B is only for enemy warnings).
